soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. The main claim is ontological and meta-logical. Z3/FOL assumes a nonempty domain, so encoding ∃x(x ≠ ∅) would either be trivially true under standard semantics or merely assert the existence of a nonempty set in an unspecified set-theoretic universe. The file does not provide a precise first-order theory of 'Something', 'Nothing', absolute non-existence, or the empty set sufficient to avoid assuming the intended conclusion.
